summary.headline: Thursday's call set the next steps: get your website back online and move your contacts into GHL.
summary.body: Done so far: your logins use your own domain, the time zone is Eastern, and the newsletter assistant wrote its first test issue. Next: bringing the website back (it shows a "page not found" message right now), moving your clients, leads and notes into GHL, and a booking calendar linked from the newsletter. Still open: domain auto-renew and business texting registration.
summary.needs_you: Yilian: give Meghan admin access to GoDaddy and Cloudflare, and upload the FRS tips and brand files to the shared folder. Maria and Yilian: pick the video for your free agent training.
summary.next_call: Thu, Nov 5 at 10:30 AM ET (9:30 AM CT). Every Thursday after that.
